subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Three Realms of the Cosmos
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Three Realms of the Cosmos.

hook.text: Heaven, earth, and underworld. Almost every cosmology divides reality into three vertical layers.

buildup.text: Norse myth has Asgard, Midgard, and Hel. Hindu cosmology has Svarga, Prithvi, and Patala. Same structure.

discovery.text: The World Tree connects all three. In shamanic traditions, the shaman travels the tree to visit each realm.

twist.text: Modern science kept the pattern: atmosphere, biosphere, lithosphere. We still think in three vertical layers.

climax.text: Three realms make the cosmos navigable. Up is divine, down is death, and we live in between.

punchline.text: Above. Below. Here. That's the whole map.

quiz.question: What connects the three cosmic realms in many mythologies?
